edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the recipient address for minted tokens
whenSaleStarted modifier gates mint execution on _saleStarted
_price is multiplied by _nbTokens to compute the msg.value requirement
_nbTokens drives the price arithmetic and the mint loop bound
maxSupply bounds the supply arithmetic in mint
mint invokes the _safeMint external callback path
_safeMint calls onERC721Received on the recipient contract before token state is finalized
flipSaleStarted is restricted by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to owner()
flipSaleStarted toggles the _saleStarted state variable
flipSaleStarted calls setStartingIndex when the sale is opened
flipSaleStarted reads startingIndex to decide whether to initialize it
_URI parameter is consumed by setBaseURI

_newPrice parameter is consumed by setPrice
setPrice writes the _price state variable
provenanceHash parameter is consumed by setProvenanceHash
setProvenanceHash writes the HAR_PROVENANCE state variable
_owner parameter is used to enumerate owned token ids
_number drives the reserved mint loop arithmetic and _reserved decrement
_receiver is used as the mint recipient in claimReserved
claimReserved also invokes the _safeMint external callback path
_reserved bounds _number and is decremented after minting

setStartingIndex writes the startingIndex state variable

withdraw is restricted by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to owner()

withdraw sends funds to the hardcoded Ines address

saleStarted view returns the _saleStarted state variable
